title: ID generators (run, persona, event, finding) + ISO-8601 timestamp helpers
acceptance: packages/core/src/ids.ts exports newRunId(), newEventId(), newFindingId(), newSignalId(), newArtifactId(), newInterviewId() with stable, collision-resistant prefixes (run_, evt_, F-, fs_, art_, iv_)
packages/core/src/time.ts exports nowIsoUtc(), parseIsoUtc(), isoToEpochMs(), epochMsToIso(), normalizeIsoToUtc() with strict timezone handling
Tests: ids unique across 10k samples (>=48-bit random suffix); time roundtrip preserves millisecond precision
